purpose: One player craft update over a borrowed typed player/world projection, with ordered publication, read-plane selection and collision-neighbourhood requests. The existing player arrays remain the persistent owner.

inputs: Selected PlayerPhysicsView: raw X32/Y32, cached pixel X/Y, platform word, raw velocity words, impact/thrust and four raw nonzero input words. Both physical players are supported; no cache/position consistency restriction.
World timer, water pixel word, selected impact-limit word, fade words and rain byte; readonly platform prefix. Every scalar word/byte pattern is admitted; signedness is explicit.
Ordered sample replies contain ten full bytes. Physics tests bit7; the exported sampler retains the OR of all80 input bits and its complete AL/flags ABI.
outputs: Interleaved named state writes, plane-register selection/read-plane requests, probes from cached pixel origins with wrapping four-pixel-column/96-cell-row displacements, and normal completion.

Position, current pixel caches, platform, velocities, greater reflected-component impact, thrust rate, shared timer and conditional fade writes. Private continuation and outstanding sample reply are observable protocol state.
effects: Publish each native write before the following physical sample. Requests are consumed in order, exact native plane and location are bound, and the full working projection agrees at sampling and normal completion.

The retained checked shell preserves every register/flag, the saved water-state stack word, all four near return words and ordered ports/reads. Pixel services synchronously refresh physical VGA latches; no early-out sampling.
preconditions: Ordinary disjoint RAM/resources/stack and native player/world/process/platform storage, stable resource inputs, synchronous reads with no player/world mutation; accessible ten-byte sample input.

Bridge native admission: canonical data/code segments, even player byte index0 or2, a negative platform-left sentinel within10 entries, and selected difficulty index0..2. All raw threshold values remain full16bit. Other bindings/indices/malformed prefixes execute the exact checked literal shell as compatibility.
The difficulty guard is necessary: an invalid wrapping lookup can alias live player writes, so entry-time limit import would be unsound. This is recorded rather than a hidden domain reduction.

L0 sampler observations exclude AF, which OR leaves undefined, matching the maintained sampler suite; movement consumes SF only. L1/native proofs and compiled cases still compare the entire flag word. No AF-zero input restriction was introduced.

Native continuations come from begin/poll/reply; a pending sample must receive exactly one reply. Platform count is at most10 and the ordinary borrowed prefix includes its negative sentinel. No normalized velocities, positive timers, positive coordinates or initialized caches are assumed.

callers: Only RunGameFromPassword calls movement, at original GAME:0DD2. Its equality-only player-loop bug remains in the accepted literal session shell.
Movement calls the sampler at11C1,11EB,1366,1383. Direct sampler entry admits arbitrary ES:SI, including physical aliases and non-VGA memory.

services: Synchronous selected-background collision image reads; existing platform_out and physical aperture read implementation. No item, actor, audio or score service is introduced.

indirect.classification: Four fixed near sample calls, bound to the exact native request and retained return word. No stored callback, actor handler or new session caller.

owned: Working projection only: existing selected PlayerX32/Y32, PlayerPixelX/YPixels, PlayerPlatformIndices, PlayerHorizontal/VerticalVelocities, PlayerImpactMagnitude and PlayerThrustAnimationRate words; LevelTimer and conditional ScreenFadeStep/Level writes.
No second persistent player allocation. No previous-page PlayerCachedPixelX/Y, cached sprite, carried passenger/stone, fare/HUD, actor alias or actor render history is written.
borrowed: Four input words, water/weather, selected impact resource and platform left/right/height prefix; cached pixels are imported at pre-update cuts.

The platform supplies the BackgroundPagePointer resource, raw signed row-stride word and current VGA read configuration. Native code contains no segment, address, port number, register model or aperture access.
memory.projection: Actual constructor and full working-state equality predicate have independent actual-C properties. Stores use native values; planes/probe origins are bound even for private-only mutants. Every other native/resource byte is framed, and all literal RAM stores are confined by the proved consuming helper and checked source inventory.

assumptions: B combines nine actual-C branch output pieces, independent arbitrary-byte native/resource frame and inactive-input dependence, actual sampler/primitive properties, and bridge constructor/consume/completion/append/poll properties. Zero-event paths retain unconditional control/dependence checks.

Address construction splits at the actual signed multiply expression: inputs are asserted equal, its complete operand-pair domain and exact range are exhaustively enumerated, and arbitrary shared product results discharge the parent. No stride or coordinate slice restriction is substituted for the full domain.

Platform search uses the actual one-candidate stop/pass/match property at an arbitrary physical index plus the actual byte-index increment seam. Ascending source-loop inventory, immutable resources and a negative sentinel within10 entries compose the first-hit search by induction; the failed combined array profile is not credited.

Loop backedges assert cursor/candidate/direction and plane/displacement equality; every retained private continuation field is checked. Literal operation inventory includes every original assignment, call, arithmetic/comparison and unary operation with at least its original multiplicity.

Sampler byte services have the existing physical-aperture read contract. Only the endpoint CPU register/flag state is observable during these synchronous reads; the physical reader does not inspect Regs. Full device/RAM/ABI/service composition is independently exercised against L0 by routine and whole-game evidence.
eliminated: Ordinary native code contains no original addresses, machine registers/flags, memory accessors, segment arithmetic or dispatch. A borrowed player view and resumable ordered requests replace their semantic roles.
No dead-register claim, recomputed cache, collision RGB threshold, speed normalization, clipping, friction or timer saturation is introduced.
retained: Word wrapping before signed comparisons, raw velocity SAR6 and clamps[-6144,6144]; X32 clamps[-512,9728], Y32[-608,6112] after wrapping integration. There is no horizontal screen-edge wrap. The water surface snap is a further wrapping expression without a second clamp.

Left beats right. Down beats up only in the airborne negative-water-byte branch. Thrust contributions are3Fh/5Ah, while vertical acceleration is70; weather adds a signed horizontal32-multiple and absolute SAR1 vertical contribution. Timer subtraction wraps per craft.

Water classification uses cached Y-water+18: signed positive forces high byte1; zero and wrapped/signed negative words retain their high byte. Submerged positive velocity subtracts193; nonpositive subtracts21 and releases platform. Surface crossing uses <=0.

Reflection is SAR1 of wrapped negation. Magnitude is the absolute doubled reflected word, with signed greater-component comparison, odd-speed rounding and8000h behaviour retained. Landing requires negative reflected vertical velocity and signed impact strictly below the raw difficulty limit.

Landing scans ascending, stops on negative left, compares raw height equality and inclusive signed bounds for wrapping cached X+16. First match stores platform then zeroes horizontal/vertical velocities. Attached players skip the horizontal block for the entire current call.

Horizontal left decrements/selects once and repeatedly samples one address; right advances read plane and cell per probe. Vertical up subtracts96 once and reuses it; down advances96 per probe. Cached X is updated before vertical address construction; cached Y remains pre-update.

Sampler offsets0,3,5,720h,723h,725h,240h,245h,480h,485h wrap individually as16-bit effective offsets. No clipping. Physical A0000..AFFFF reads refresh all four latches, using selected read plane in mode0 or existing compare/care state in mode1; the last physical VGA read owns final latches. Masks for writes do not affect reads.

Plane selection is never restored. BackgroundPagePointer, not display/draw page, is sampled. Initial signed IMUL uses the raw row-stride word; footprint/scan96-cell rows remain fixed even for another stride. Physical aliases/non-VGA direct sampler inputs retain their literal meaning.

The complete retained ABI shell is regenerated from actual C; no register/flag deadness claim is used. Ordinary disjoint RAM/resources/stack, valid selected physical slot and a negative platform-left sentinel within ten borrowed entries are explicit B assumptions; all scalar words and cached histories are arbitrary.

amiga.finding: docs/amiga.md explains craft control, gravity and attachment. DOS reimplemented the fixed-point scale, palette-bit collision scan, acceleration and thresholds; no Amiga arithmetic, mask, timing or bug equivalence is claimed.

uncertainty: Admitted states can diverge exactly as DOS: cached Y=water Y=1042, raw Y32=1, velocity0, attached platform0 snap target Y32 to8000h. With clear pixels the up-scan residue1 never reaches the signed minimum. No production guard was added; invariant B and controlled L0/C prefixes are separate from terminating scenarios.
Only review changes this new component administrative status. Platform pixel services and the whole session stay with existing owners.
The accepted actor_render generated RunGameFromPassword session-body copy remains debt. This unit replaces its movement callee and retires none of that shell.

Synchronous compatibility services must preserve exact read order and cache cuts; a future port may provide an equivalent shadow collision image, but may not replace these requests with a clipped/normalized geometry predicate.
